annotations.text:
Advaya Care storefront — four key pages.

Built on the existing brand: gold on warm near-black, Cormorant Garamond with Jost. Real catalog, real prices, real stock levels from the live store.

For Zoho Commerce implementation via the Theme Editor.

"Image pending" cards are the four products with no photography: Sunscreen SPF50, Cleansing Delight Soap, Jeevita Facial Soap, Coat Freshening Mist.

Sold-out states shown on the three products currently at zero stock.

Cart shows the MYFIRST 25% coupon and the ₹99 domestic shipping rate already configured in Zoho.

GST shown as included — prices are MRP-inclusive.
